Name: Spawn Monsters
Author: Beris4n
Description:
[code]﻿[/code]With this mod, you can use a command or a Menu to spawn monsters anywhere!

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Using the SMAPI console, you can enter five new commands:

[code]monster_menu
[/code]
[size=1]opens a menu for spawning monsters[/size]

[code]﻿monster_list[/code]
[size=1]prints the names of the monsters you can spawn.[/size]

[code]﻿monster_spawn "Name" [positionX] [positionY] [amount][/code]
[size=1]spawns <amount> monsters at given (or at the Farmer's) coordinates. Exclude the brackets.[/size]

[code]farmer_position[/code]
[size=1]prints your current position, for use with monster_spawn[/size]

[code]remove_prismatic_jelly[/code]
﻿[size=1]removes all Prismatic Jelly from your inventory[/size]

Example:

monster_spawn "Green Slime" 10 47 20
[size=1]﻿spawns 20 green slimes at 10, 47[/size]

[size=3]You can configure a hotkey (default: P) to open the menu!
[/size]Look for a config.json in the mod folder after running the mod once!

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI 3.8+
[*]Works in singleplayer, and should work in multiplayer (in moderation).
[/list]

[size=5]Source Code
[/size]
[list]
[*]View it on [url=https://github.com/Berisan/SpawnMonsters]GitHub[/url]﻿
[/list]
